kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-01.title: Check each letter
kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-01.body:
Written vertically, the word is symmetric exactly when **every letter** has a vertical line of symmetry. O, T and M have one; R, B and L do not. ROOT has R, BOOM and BOOT have B, LOOT has L. Only TOOT works.

**Answer: (E) TOOT**

kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-05.title: Count the turns
kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-05.body:
From $A$ every route goes down 4 levels, each time to the lower-left or lower-right. $B$ is the second dot from the left in the bottom row, so a route to $B$ makes exactly **one** step to the right and three to the left. The right step can be the 1st, 2nd, 3rd or 4th step: 4 routes.

**Answer: (C) 4**

kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-05.title: Write numbers at the dots
kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-05.body:
Write at each dot the number of ways to reach it: each number is the sum of the numbers of the dots with arrows into it. Row by row: 1; 1, 1; 1, 2, 1; 1, 3, 3, 1; 1, 4, 6, 4, 1. $B$ gets 4.

**Answer: (C) 4**

kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-10.title: Smallest such year
kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-10.body:
The prime digits are 2, 3, 5 and 7. Years from 2018 to 2999 start with 2, so the next digit must be prime too: at least 2, so the year is at least 2200, and then the smallest choice is 2222. Check that no year between 2018 and 2222 works: any year from 2019 to 2199 has second digit 0 or 1, which are not prime; from 2200 to 2221 the last two digits contain 0 or 1. So the next year is 2222, which is $2222 - 2018 = 204$ years away.

**Answer: (D) 204**

kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-19.title: List the next palindromes
kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-19.body:
In 3 hours at most 100 km/h he drives at most 300 km, so the final reading is at most 30092. The palindromes after 29792 are 29892, 29992, 30003, 30103, ... The largest one not above 30092 is 30003, which is $30003 - 29792 = 211$ km further. His maximum average speed is $\frac{211}{3}$ km/h.

**Answer: (C) $\frac{211}{3}$ km/h**

kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-20.title: Try the options
kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-20.body:
His birthday has passed, so if he is $n$ years old he was born in $2018 - n$.

- 5: born 2013, digit sum 6 ✗
- 7: born 2011, digit sum 4 ✗
- 9: born 2009, digit sum 11 ✗
- 11: born 2007, digit sum 9 ✗
- 10: born 2008, digit sum $2 + 0 + 0 + 8 = 10$ ✓

**Answer: (E) 10 years old**

kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-20.title: Set up an equation
kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-20.body:
For a birth year $\overline{20ab}$: age $= 18 - 10a - b$ and digit sum $= 2 + a + b$. So $18 - 10a - b = 2 + a + b$, i.e. $11a + 2b = 16$, giving $a = 0$, $b = 8$. (A year $\overline{19ab}$ would need $11a + 2b = 108$, which has no digit solution.) He was born in 2008 and is 10.

**Answer: (E) 10 years old**

kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-28.title: Totals
kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-28.body:
The six members weigh $6 \cdot 60 = 360$ kg; all eight weigh $8 \cdot 58 = 464$ kg. So Ann and Sophie together weigh $104$ kg. With Ann 8 kg heavier: Ann $= (104 + 8)/2 = 56$ kg.

**Answer: (E) 56**

kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-28.title: Deviations from 58
kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-28.body:
The six members are each 2 kg above the new mean 58: 12 kg in total. So Ann and Sophie together are 12 kg below $2 \cdot 58$, i.e. they weigh $116 - 12 = 104$ kg; Ann weighs $56$ kg and Sophie $48$ kg.

**Answer: (E) 56**

kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-29.title: Pairs with equal product
kangaroo-ca-2018-g0708-29.body:
Each of the four straight lines passes through the centre $c$ and two opposite outer circles. So every opposite pair must have the same product $k$, and the line product is $c \cdot k$. We need 4 different pairs of different numbers with product $k$, none of them equal to $c$.

- $c = 1$: we need $k$ with 4 factor pairs not using 1, i.e. at least 10 divisors. The smallest such number is 48: $2\cdot24, 3\cdot16, 4\cdot12, 6\cdot8$. Product $1 \cdot 48 = 48$.
- $c = 2$: $k$ needs 8 divisors, so $k \ge 24$, and $k = 24$ uses $2 \cdot 12$, leaving only 3 pairs; so $k > 24$ and the product is more than $2 \cdot 24 = 48$.
- $c \ge 3$: a product below 48 means $k \le 15$, and no number up to 15 has 8 divisors.

So the least product is 48.

**Answer: (C) 48**
